description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class 'DisplayHotplugHelperApp' that logs display information for testing purposes in the Cuttlefish display hotplug testing framework.

classes.name: DisplayHotplugHelperApp
classes.description: An Android Activity that logs display information in JSON format for testing display hotplug events.

methods.name: getDisplayInfo
methods.description: Creates a JSON object containing display ID, width, and height for a given Display object.

methods.name: logDisplayInfos
methods.description: Retrieves all displays and logs their information in JSON format with a logging identifier.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android lifecycle method called when activity is created; initiates display info logging.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Android lifecycle method called when a new intent is received; logs display info with a new UUID.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Android lifecycle method called when activity resumes; logs resume event.
